user.title: Z-Wave multicast cover group
user.description: Combine Z-Wave covers into one cover that moves them with a single Z-Wave multicast frame, so they start at the same moment.

data_description.entities: Z-Wave JS covers that report a position. Non-secure members on the same controller are sent one multicast; the rest are sent the normal command.
data_description.travel_time: Seconds the slowest member needs end to end. The group shows opening/closing for this long, then checks each member really arrived and re-sends to any that didn't.

error.not_position_cover: Every member must be a Z-Wave JS cover that reports a position.
